pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark regions with smoothed edge gradients due to image resolution. Patch spatial area increases from the upper neck towards the shoulder, transitioning from smaller, elongated shapes to larger, more equilateral polygons.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways forming a topological mesh with frequent tri-radiate junction nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the visible flank, maintaining high connectivity.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated contour along the dorsal neck ridge, representing the 1D silhouette of the mane against the background.
